name: MySQL Server
summary: Structural draft for MySQL Server at fixed commit 561753af986c. Current official documentation describes a pluggable storage-engine boundary and InnoDB structures, but this card does not promote those claims because the documentation is not pinned to the analyzed source revision and the fixed source evidence has not yet been inspected semantically.

features.name: Observable repository structure
features.description: The inspected revision contains 61024 files, top-level entries .clang-format, .clang-tidy, .gitconfig, .github, CMakeLists.txt, CONTRIBUTING.md, Docs, Doxyfile-ignored, Doxyfile.in, INSTALL, LICENSE, MYSQL_VERSION, and source languages including C, C++, C/C++ headers, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Python, SQL, Shell, YAML.
benefits: Provides a reproducible baseline for later modeling.
costs: Repository metrics do not by themselves explain runtime behavior.

features.name: Architecture-related path signals
features.description: Path names contain these weak, non-semantic signals: compiler, concurrency, media, networking, orchestration, query-execution, storage, virtualization. They identify targets for source review, not proof of runtime architecture.
benefits: Prioritizes files for evidence-backed semantic analysis.
costs: Names can be historical, incidental, or misleading.

benefits: Identifies the first deterministic entry points for deeper analysis.
costs: A marker is evidence of a tool, not proof of the complete build architecture.
